transcript:
User: Make it quick, I'm on a job site. Forty-five seconds.
Agent: Got it, I’ll keep it tight.  

Are you calling in from an ad you saw, a voicemail from Jay, or were you just searching for help with missed calls?
User: Searching for help with missed calls. I miss 25 calls a week. What's your solution? Fast.
Agent: Totally, here it is in one line: we pick up those 25 missed calls for you, turn them into booked jobs or messages, so you stop losing that revenue.  

When those calls hit you now, are they going to voicemail or just ringing out?
User: Voicemails mostly, but I can't get to them in time. What's the cost and setup time?
Agent: Gotcha — that’s exactly what we fix for other contractors.  

Before we talk numbers, mind if I do a super quick calculation on what those 25 missed calls are costing you each week?
User: No need for calculations. I lose 45% of 25 calls. What's your price and setup time?
Agent: Got it, I hear you — straight to it.  

So… we stop those voicemail losses by answering for you and booking jobs; pricing depends on call volume and setup, but contractors usually land in the low four figures per month, and setup is typically a few days once we plug into your phone system.  

Given you’re losing almost half of 25 calls a week, are you more worried about keeping costs down or making sure every one of those calls gets turned into a job?
User: Stop talking. I need to turn calls into jobs. Can you handle it or not? Price? Setup?
Agent: Yes — we can handle it. We turn those missed calls into booked jobs and messages for you.  

Pricing: most small contractors land roughly in the low four figures per month, depending on call volume.  
Setup: usually a few days once we connect to your phone system and set your scripts.  

Are you missing calls all day, or is it mainly when you’re on the tools and after hours?
User: Mostly when I'm on machinery. Price for 25 calls? Can you start setup today? That's what I need to know.
Agent: Got it, you’re on machines, missing money in real time.  

Here’s the honest answer: price for your 25 calls a week and “can we start today” both depend on how your phone system’s set up and exactly how you want those calls handled, and that’s something Jay has to look at with you live — I can’t quote a real number or flip the switch without that.  

If we can get you from “25 calls, losing 45%” to those turning into booked jobs, are you okay with something in that low four-figure-per-month range if the numbers make sense when you see it?
User: Fine, if it catches those calls, schedule the demo. Call me at +13055550003, Eastern time. Get it done.
Agent: Perfect, that’s exactly what the demo is for — Jay will walk you through how we’d catch those calls for you and what it really costs on your numbers. I’ll have our team call you at +1 (305) 555-0003 in Eastern time to schedule and run that demo. If anything changes with that number or your availability, just let us know. Thanks for squeezing this in on the job site — talk soon.
